assets.prompt: Create one entirely new 3:2 landscape natural editorial photograph using the people in the references only for identity. Image1 approved fictional four-person team; image2 is consultant01 male, black long hair in low ponytail, navy jacket and white shirt, clean shaven; image3 consultant04 female, neat dark bob, taupe blazer and light blouse. Preserve these exact two faces and ages, attractive awake professional appearance. Scene: preliminary urban-renewal site visit on a dry Taipei residential lane in soft daylight. Old four-story tiled apartment buildings behind them, coherent doors/balconies, safe level sidewalk, no active construction, no hard hats or random measuring tools. One NEW distinct Taiwanese male homeowner aged 56, stocky build, round face, close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair, no glasses, muted forest-green polo, stands in RIGHT foreground in three-quarter back/profile, facing the consultants on LEFT and CENTER. Consultant01 stands center, holds a single rigid A3 site-plan clipboard securely at waist level with BOTH hands at separate lower corners, paper flat on support, top tilted toward homeowner for homeowner to read. Plan has an aerial block image and simple parcel outlines without legible text, no invented fancy architecture. Consultant04 stands slightly left beside him, hands relaxed separately at waist, speaking calmly to homeowner about the preliminary boundary; she is actively engaged, not a background model. Consultant01 is listening to homeowner; both consultants' heads AND eyes align naturally toward the homeowner's face at their eye level. Camera is just to homeowner's left, so both consultants faces are nearly frontal with BOTH eyes clearly open, normal visible aligned pupils, no exaggerated sideways eye turn, not looking at camera. Homeowner listens to consultant04 with head turned naturally toward her, not the viewer. Nobody looks down, squints, looks sleepy or stares romantically at colleague. All three people fit within central 80 percent, waist-up medium-wide with faces and hands large enough to inspect. Realistic fingers, grips, wrists, arms, shoulders and body proportions; no hands crossing or overlapping, no chin-resting, no hands touching faces, no pointing, no floating paper. Neutral daylight and believable lived-in building materials, dry sidewalk absolutely no wet reflections. No posed team portrait, model, logo, watermark, overlaid text, cinematic grade or glow.

assets.prompt: Generate a new 3:2 landscape candid editorial photograph of an early-stage urban-renewal working discussion, not a team portrait. Identity references: image1 approved fictional team; image2 consultant01 male with black long hair in low ponytail, navy suit, white shirt, handsome natural face; image3 consultant04 female with chin-length dark bob and taupe suit, beautiful awake natural face. Preserve their exact identities. NEW distinct homeowner representative: Taiwanese woman aged 51, long narrow face, silver-streaked short curly hair, thin rectangular burgundy glasses, plum cardigan over cream top, average build, different from all consultant faces and the existing curly black-haired olive-blouse homeowner. Scene in a bright practical community project room. A wall-mounted working board contains two alternative simple block plans and a discreet month-by-month preliminary-work schedule at EYE LEVEL, with only indistinct small text. Consultant01 stands on LEFT facing homeowner on RIGHT, speaking to her with relaxed hands resting separately on a waist-high table, no pointing. The female consultant stands CENTER, beside rather than close to male, holding a rigid OPEN cost-comparison binder flat supported on the table; her left hand rests on the left page and right hand lightly holds the edge, realistic separate fingers. Pages face the homeowner, not camera, charts and cost rows are small and not legible. She has paused explaining and is listening directly to homeowner at EYE LEVEL, head upright, both eyes fully naturally open and aligned pupils. Homeowner stands on RIGHT in 3/4 profile, speaking to the male while resting one hand on her own side of the table, other hand relaxed. Camera looks from homeowner's left shoulder side, showing both consultants in clear 3/4 frontal view with both eyes visible. Heads align with eyes toward the person being addressed, no sideways wandering pupils, cross eyes, blank stare, sleepy eyelids or eyes down toward table. Nobody looks at camera, at each other romantically, touches face, rests chin on hand, or points theatrically. Natural personal distance, all torsos and hands visible, safe grounded furniture, no fingers through paper/table, normal five-finger anatomy and wrists, no duplicated hands, no floating papers. Professional discussion of initial planning costs and division of work, no construction site or keys/contract signing. Soft neutral daylight, real skin texture, simple believable room, dry floor, no fake dramatic luxury, no logos, watermark, overlaid captions, film color grade or glow. Keep all three faces and key actions in central 80 percent for responsive website cropping.
